item.title: 🍽 HUB1 - Sprout Lunch Menu:
item.description: 🍽 HUB1 - Sprout Lunch Menu: A selection of fresh seasonal vegetables that you can combine with a protein of your choice to create your own meal salad.

item.title: 🍽 HUB1 - Homebound Lunch Menu:
item.description: 🍽 HUB1 - Homebound Lunch Menu: Beef rissoles with oven-baked potato slices and vegetables, topped with chives. Served with cucumber salad and bravas sauce. Also available gluten free. (1+6+15)

item.title: 🍽 HUB1 - Globetrotter Lunch Menu:
item.description: 🍽 HUB1 - Globetrotter Lunch Menu: Jamaican brown stew chicken, served with traditional rice and peas and topped with thyme. Served with a crisp Caribbean coleslaw. The dish is gluten free. (15) GREEN DISH: Dish Jamaican brown stew tofu, served with traditional rice and peas and topped with thyme. Served with a crisp Caribbean coleslaw. The dish is gluten free. (7+15)

item.title: 🍽 HUB3 - Lunch Menu:
item.description: 🍽 HUB3 - Lunch Menu: Provençal-style ratatouille vegetables with roasted chicken and a salad of fresh herbs. (15) GREEN DISH: Dish Provençal-style ratatouille vegetables with dill patties and a salad of fresh herbs. (15)

item.title: 🍽 HUB2 - Lunch Menu:
item.description: 🍽 HUB2 - Lunch Menu: Butter chicken, the Indian favourite in a creamy tomato sauce, served with rice. (6) GREEN DISH: Dish Butter paneer, the Indian favourite in a creamy tomato sauce, served with rice. (6)

item.title: 🍽 HUB1 – Kays - Lunch Menu:
item.description: 🍽 HUB1 – Kays - Lunch Menu: Italian bolognese in a baked potato, topped with parmesan and gremolata. Served with roasted Italian vegetables, chilli sauce and garlic cream.
